offlineDraft.deviceDraftText: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present. Mould was observed again in the back bedroom, with an increase in severity near the window. The landlord had not responded to two emails sent. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the deadline for a benefits form last week; the form was present on the table with a DOB of 3/3/87. It was agreed that I would call the landlord on Monday. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday, and Tomas Brandvold offered to help with the form. A risk of rent arrears is noted should the form be submitted late. A follow-up is scheduled for (place not put back).

finishedText: Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present at the visit on 12/11. Mould was seen in the back bedroom again, and it was worse by the window. The landlord had not replied to 2 emails. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline, a letter was present, and the date of birth on the form was 3/3/87. It was agreed that the worker will ring the landlord on Monday, Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday, and Tomas Brandvold (neighbour, also on my list) offered to help Maria Okonkwo-Reyes with the form. The risks are rent arrears if the form is late. The next steps are to revisit on 26/11.
